instruction: Extract the invoice data from the PDF in my Google Drive and create a single-sheet LibreOffice Calc file named 'invoice.xlsx' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: This task verifies that the extracted invoice data is saved in a single-sheet workbook (not multiple sheets). The evaluator counts the number of sheets in the xlsx file and checks it equals 1.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Incomplete verification coverage - instruction requires extracting invoice data from PDF, but evaluator only checks if file has 1 sheet
Missing content verification - evaluator does not verify that invoice data was actually extracted from the PDF or that any data exists in the sheet
Evaluator would pass for an empty single-sheet xlsx file, even though the main task (extracting invoice data) was not completed
Only verifies structural requirement (single-sheet) while ignoring semantic requirement (invoice data extraction)
Filename verification missing - hardcoded path assumes filename is correct but doesn't verify it
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to extract actual cell data/content from the xlsx file to verify invoice data is present
Add metric to check that extracted data matches expected invoice fields (e.g., invoice number, date, amount, line items)
Consider adding verification that the file is not empty (has rows with data)
Add check to verify the filename is actually 'invoice.xlsx' rather than hardcoding the path
Consider verifying that data structure matches typical invoice format (headers, rows, totals)
